session.title: Secure session unavailable
session.description: Sign in again to open the organization workspace.

hero.title: Organization & People
hero.description: Manage Office structure, people placement and leadership through the configurable OrgUnit hierarchy and authorized organizational scope.

readonly.title: Read-only organization view
readonly.description: You can review this hierarchy, but no organization changes are available in your current authorized scope.
readonly.unit: This unit is read-only in your current authorized scope.

tree.title: Office structure
tree.description: Expand any branch to view Division, Department, Section, Unit, Sub-Unit, Team or other configured OrgUnits.
tree.loadingDescription: Please wait while the latest authorized hierarchy is loaded.
tree.noOfficeDescription: No active or visible Office is available for this account.
tree.emptyDescription: Change the search or status filter to view another part of the hierarchy.

detail.title: Organization details
detail.officeDescription: Select an organizational unit from the hierarchy to review its details and available actions.
detail.selectUnit: Choose a unit from the hierarchy to review its placement and current authorized actions.

editor.name: Unit name
editor.validCodeName: Enter a valid unit code and name.
editor.moveNotice: Moving a unit keeps its identity and history. The backend prevents cycles and unauthorized destinations.
editor.deactivateNotice: Deactivation is allowed only after active child units, memberships and leadership are moved or ended.
editor.activateNotice: The parent unit and organization type must be active before this unit can be activated.

errors.operationFailed: The organization operation could not be completed.
errors.actionContextFailed: Available organization actions could not be loaded.

people.title: People & Placement
people.description: Review current Office placement, placement history and authorized internal assignment actions without using legacy Division or Department roles.
people.searchPlaceholder: Name, staff ID, designation or unit
people.emptyDescription: Change the search or review another Office.
people.selectDescription: Choose a person to review current placement and placement history.
people.membershipReadonly: Membership history is not available in your current authorized scope.
people.targetScopeNotice: The selected destination is outside your current placement authority.
people.endNotice: Ending a secondary or temporary placement preserves its complete history. Primary placement must be changed using Transfer.
people.secondarySummary_one: {{count}} secondary or temporary placement is currently active for the selected employee.
people.secondarySummary_other: {{count}} secondary or temporary placements are currently active for the selected employee.

errors.load: Office people could not be loaded.
errors.detail: Employee placement details could not be loaded.
errors.save: The placement action could not be completed.
errors.reason: Provide a clear reason containing at least 3 characters.
errors.temporaryEnd: Temporary placement requires an end time.
errors.targetNotAllowed: You are not authorized for the selected placement scope.

leadership.title: Leadership & Acting Assignments
leadership.description: Review current and historical leadership, then manage authorized Head, Team Lead, Deputy and temporary Acting assignments by organizational scope.
leadership.searchPlaceholder: Employee, staff ID, unit or leadership type
leadership.readonlyScope: Leadership changes are read-only for this scope.
leadership.deputyNotice: Deputy is a separate leadership assignment and does not automatically receive Head authority.
leadership.actingNotice: Acting leadership is temporary. An effective end time is required and the backend applies authority only during that period.
leadership.endNotice: Ending an open assignment preserves its complete history. Permanent Office Head remains a protected system action.
leadership.emptyDescription: Change the scope, period status or search to review another leadership record.
leadership.scheduledEnd: Ends automatically at the scheduled time
leadership.noTeamsNotice: No active OrgUnit is currently configured as a Team, so Team Lead assignment is unavailable until a Team unit exists.

errors.load: Leadership assignments could not be loaded.
errors.actions: Leadership actions could not be loaded for the selected scope.
errors.save: The leadership action could not be completed.
errors.selection: Select an authorized leadership scope, role and employee.
errors.reason: Provide a clear reason containing at least 3 characters.
errors.actingEnd: Acting leadership requires an effective end time.
errors.scope: You are not authorized for this leadership action in the selected scope.
